title: Day 103: IRGC 'Operation True Promise IV' Strikes Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan in Retaliation for US Hormuz Strikes
detail: IRGC claimed drone strikes on the US Fifth Fleet in Bahrain and Ali Al Salem airbase in Kuwait, plus a long-range missile strike on Azraq airbase, Jordan, in retaliation for the June 9 US strikes near Hormuz. IRGC claimed 21 US targets hit, 4 destroyed, including an F-35 hangar in Jordan. Jordan's military said it intercepted all 20 missiles fired toward Azraq — no casualties or damage. Bahrain sounded air-raid sirens twice; Kuwait said its air defenses intercepted 'hostile aerial targets.' All three governments reported no casualties.

media.caption: IRGC 'True Promise IV' strikes hit Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan
